custodes-auric-champions.ruleText: At the start of your Command phase, pick one unit in your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, whenever a model in an Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER unit from your army attacks that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Blade Imperator
enhancements.text:
Adeptus Custodes model only. Each time the bearer's unit finishes a Charge move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll a D6: on 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Once per battle, after the bearer's unit finishes a Charge move, every enemy unit within 6" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.text:
Adeptus Custodes model only. The bearer's Leadership characteristic is 5+.
Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you may pick one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 12" of the bearer that is Battle-shocked; it stops being Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Martial Philosopher
enhancements.text:
Adeptus Custodes model only. The bearer's unit can shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Once per battle, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer, the bearer's unit may make a Normal move of up to 6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

enhancements.name: Veiled Blade
enhancements.text:
Adeptus Custodes model only. The bearer's melee weapons get +2 to their Attacks characteristic.
Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, the bearer's Objective Control characteristic is tripled until the end of that turn.

stratagems.name: Slayer of Champions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase.
TARGET: One Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the enemy unit you picked for your Assemblage of Might ability at the start of your Command phase.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, whenever an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army attacks that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll. Also, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: Shoulder the Mantle
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
TARGET: One Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER model from your army that is not currently leading a unit.
EFFECT: Pick one friendly unit within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it is allowed to lead (per the Leader section of its datasheet); Battle-shocked units and units that are already Attached cannot be picked. Your model joins that unit as its Leader, and that unit's Starting Strength is adjusted to account for it.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase.
TARGET: One Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER model from your army that has just been destroyed and has not yet fought this phase. You may use this Stratagem on it even though it was just destroyed.
EFFECT: Leave your destroyed model on the battlefield for now. Once the attacking unit has finished all its attacks, your model can fight, after which it is removed from play.

stratagems.name: Earning of a Name
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase.
TARGET: Up to two Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER units from your army that have not yet been picked to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a CHARACTER model in either of those units attacks a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you may re-roll the Hit roll and you may re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: The Emperor’s Auspice
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has picked its targets.
TARGET: One Adeptus Custodes CHARACTER unit from your army that was picked as a target for one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, CHARACTER models in your unit have Feel No Pain 4+.

stratagems.name: Superhuman Reserves
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, right after an Adeptus Custodes WARLORD model from your army has used a Once per battle ability from its datasheet or from an Enhancement.
TARGET: That Adeptus Custodes WARLORD model.
EFFECT: Your model may use that Once per battle ability one extra time this battle, but not again in the same phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

tyranids-assimilation-swarm.ruleText:
In your Command phase, every HARVESTER unit in your army may Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of it. No unit can be regenerated more than once per phase. Whenever a unit regenerates, pick one option:
- One of its models heals up to D3+1 lost wounds.
- One destroyed INFANTRY model (not a CHARACTER) is returned to the unit with all its wounds. If the unit is an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, return up to 3 destroyed models instead of one.

enhancements.name: Biophagic Flow
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While a friendly HARVESTER model is within 12" of the bearer, that HARVESTER can use Feed the Swarm to Regenerate a friendly TYRANIDS unit up to 9" away instead of 6".

enhancements.name: Instinctive Defence
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of at least one friendly HARVESTER unit, using the Heroic Intervention stratagem on this unit costs 1 CP less, and models in the bearer's unit have Fights First.

enhancements.name: Parasitic Biomorphology
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Melee weapons of models in the bearer's unit get +1 Strength. The first time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit during the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of at least one friendly HARVESTER unit, those melee weapons also get +1 Attacks for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only (not MONSTER models). The bearer's unit can be regenerated up to two times per phase rather than once.

stratagems.name: Rapacious Hunger
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that has just destroyed an enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit Regenerates straight away (as described in Feed the Swarm). If your unit is a HARVESTER unit and you pick the option for one model to heal up to D3 lost wounds, that model heals up to 3 lost wounds instead.

stratagems.name: Ablative Carapace
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One HARVESTER unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 5+. If your unit is within range of an objective marker that you control, they have Feel No Pain 4+ instead until the phase ends.

stratagems.name: Broodguard Impulse
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase.
TARGET: One HARVESTER unit in your army that has just been destroyed. You may use this Stratagem on it despite it having just been destroyed.
EFFECT: For the rest of the battle, whenever a friendly TYRANIDS model attacks the enemy unit that destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Secure Biomass
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, melee weapons of models in your unit gain [LETHAL HITS]. If your unit is a HARVESTER unit, its models' melee attacks also score a Critical Hit on any successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Tyrannoformed
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One HARVESTER unit in your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
EFFECT: You keep control of that objective marker even when none of your models are within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Reclaim Biomass
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit in your army is destroyed, before its last model is removed from play.
TARGET: One HARVESTER unit in your army within 6" of the destroyed unit.
EFFECT: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (as described in Feed the Swarm).

tyranids-talons-of-the-norn-queen.ruleText:
Friendly NORN EMISSARY and NORN ASSIMILATOR units gain this ability:
Protean Purpose (once per battle for each unit): in your Command phase, you may use this ability to let this unit make a new choice for its Singular Purpose ability, replacing its earlier choice.

enhancements.name: Destabilising Predation
enhancements.text: NORN EMISSARY unit only. This unit's ranged attacks gain [ANTI-CHARACTER 2+].

enhancements.name: Synaptoprescience
enhancements.text: NORN ASSIMILATOR unit only. This unit has a 4+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Tanglestrike Rounds
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot.
TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks. It becomes tethered until the start of your next Command phase; a tethered unit has its Move reduced by 2".

stratagems.name: Lesser Prey
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, at the moment a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR or NORN EMISSARY unit is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR or NORN EMISSARY unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks get +2 Strength.

stratagems.name: Catalytic Biofortification
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit takes a mortal wound.
TARGET: That NORN ASSIMILATOR unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

dark-angels-tacticus-firestorm-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

dark-angels-ironclad-champions.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

orks-flyboyz.ruleText:
Friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT units are not counted toward the total points value of your units in strategic reserves.
While a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is riled up, its ranged attacks get +1 to their hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Flyboss
enhancements.text:
ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only.
This unit gains the CHARACTER keyword.
Whenever this unit finishes an ingress move, every friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit within 6" of it becomes riled up until your next turn begins.

enhancements.name: Impulsive Recon
enhancements.text: ORKS AIRCRAFT unit only. During your first Movement phase, this unit may make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Whirligig Evasion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Movement phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a move.
TARGET: One friendly DEFFKOPTAS unit that is not engaged and is within 8" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D6", or of up to 6" if your unit is riled up.

stratagems.name: Flyin' Headbutt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before any Deadly Demise roll is made for it.
TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit loses its Deadly Demise ability. Pick one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6; for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. After that, remove your unit from the battlefield.

stratagems.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit against a FLY unit may re-roll their hit rolls.

orks-bully-boyz.ruleText: Melee attacks made by friendly MEGANOBZ and NOBZ units have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Tellyporta Boss
enhancements.text: MEGA ARMOUR model only. This model's unit has Deep Strike (unless it is a VEHICLE unit).

enhancements.name: Wimp-kickaz
enhancements.text: NOBZ unit only. Whenever an enemy unit engaged with this unit is chosen to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit is forced to use the desperate escape mode. If this unit is riled up, subtract 1 from the hazard rolls that enemy unit makes for that desperate escape.

stratagems.name: Hulking Brutes
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit picks a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit as a target.
TARGET: That MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks against your unit whose S is higher than your unit's T get -1 to their wound rolls. Alternatively, for +1CP (costing 1CP more than normal), all ranged attacks against your unit get -1 to their wound rolls instead.

stratagems.name: Too Arrogant to Die
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase, when an enemy unit picks a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit as a target.
TARGET: That MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
EFFECT: Each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is riled up. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield for now; it is removed after your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

stratagems.name: Armed to da Teef
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit is selected to make its attacks.
TARGET: That MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1. If your unit is riled up, its attacks may instead re-roll any hit roll.

orks-blitz-brigade.ruleText:
Friendly WAGON units may re-roll their charge rolls.
Whenever a friendly WAGON unit is chosen to make an advance move, you may change that unit's advance roll to a 6.

enhancements.name: Boss Boomer
enhancements.text: WAGON unit only. As long as a WARBOSS model is embarked inside this unit, this unit gains that WARBOSS model's Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin' ability.

enhancements.name: Targetin’ Gizmos
enhancements.text:
WAGON unit only. As long as a BIG MEK model is embarked inside this unit:
Ranged attacks made by this unit have [Ignores Cover].
If this unit is also riled up, its ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1] as well.

stratagems.name: Readied Brawlers
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase, right after a friendly WAGON unit finishes a normal move.
TARGET: The WAGON unit that just finished that move.
EFFECT: Any units embarked inside your unit may make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.name: Impending Krunch
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Charge phase, right after a friendly WAGON unit finishes a charge move.
TARGET: The WAGON unit that just finished that charge.
EFFECT: Every enemy unit engaged with your unit must take a battle-shock roll, subtracting 1 from that roll.

stratagems.name: Keep It Runnin'
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit that is not engaged, was eligible to fight during this phase, and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that it would be allowed to embark within.
EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks inside that TRANSPORT unit.

dark-angels-phobos-shock-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

tyranids-subterranean-assault.ruleText:
Whenever a TYRANIDS model in your army attacks, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
Tunnel Markers: whenever a BURROWER unit in your army is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, place a round 40mm Tunnel Marker anywhere within 1" of that unit and more than 3" horizontally from every enemy unit.
In the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, a unit you set up from Reserves may be placed wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units.
If any enemy model (other than AIRCRAFT) finishes any kind of move within 3" of one of your Tunnel Markers, remove that marker from the battlefield.
Keywords: MAWLOC and TRYGON units in your army gain the BURROWER keyword. During the Muster Armies step, you may pick up to 2 TRYGON models in your army; they gain the CHARACTER keyword (so they can take Enhancements, and one of them can be your WARLORD).

enhancements.name: Synaptic Strategy
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once per battle, you may use the Rapid Ingress stratagem on the bearer's unit for 0 CP, even if that Stratagem has already been used on another unit this phase.

enhancements.name: Tremor Senses
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once both players have finished deploying, pick up to three friendly TYRANIDS units in your army and redeploy them. You may place any of them into Strategic Reserves when you do, no matter how many units are already there.

enhancements.name: Trygon Prime
enhancements.text: TRYGON model only. The bearer gains the SYNAPSE keyword, and its melee weapons get +1 Strength and have their Weapon Skill improved by 1.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Intellect
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model with Deep Strike only. The bearer's unit may arrive using Deep Strike in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, whatever the mission rules say.

stratagems.name: Swarming Assault
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" of your unit may re-roll Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Enfilading Emergence
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
EFFECT: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons of models in your unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Tunnel Network
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that is wholly within 9" of at least one of your Tunnel Markers and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.
EFFECT: Take your unit off the battlefield and set it back up wholly within 9" of a different Tunnel Marker you placed and more than 6" horizontally from every enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Retreat Below
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: Either one TYRANIDS unit or up to two BURROWER units in your army, none of which are within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.
EFFECT: Take the targeted unit(s) off the battlefield and put them into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Replenishing Swarms
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that is wholly within 9" of at least one Tunnel Marker you placed.
EFFECT: Either one model in your unit heals up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you return up to D3+1 destroyed models that have a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit with all their wounds.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Optimisation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One MAWLOC or TRYGON unit in your army.
EFFECT: Your unit gains the SYNAPSE keyword until the start of your next Command phase.

orks-wreckas.ruleText:
In your Shooting phase, when you select a friendly BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit to shoot, its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 if at least one of these is true:
- That unit is within range of an objective.
- The target of the attack is within range of an objective.

enhancements.name: Kaptin's Hat
enhancements.text: BIG MEK or WARBOSS INFANTRY model only. Once both players have finished deploying, you can pick up to three friendly ORKS INFANTRY units and redeploy them. Any of those units can instead be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Supa-snazz Dakka
enhancements.text: FLASH GITZ unit only. Snazzgun weapons carried by this unit gain [Rapid Fire 1].

stratagems.name: Drive-By Bustin'
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase, at the moment a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks your unit makes with weapons chosen to fire via its Firing Deck ability get +1 to their Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: Grab It
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase, once a friendly BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit that is not Engaged has finished shooting.
TARGET: That BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a Normal move of up to 6", which must finish with it within range of an objective. Until the end of the turn, your unit cannot declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Gun-Crazy Show-Offs
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, once an enemy unit has finished shooting.
TARGET: One friendly FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit that was hit by those attacks.
EFFECT: Your unit immediately shoots as if it were your Shooting phase (normal shooting), but the only unit it may target is that enemy unit.

orks-kult-of-speed.ruleText:
Friendly WARBIKERS units gain BATTLELINE.
Whenever a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is chosen to make an advance or fall-back move: its ranged attacks gain [Assault] until the end of the turn, and making that move does not stop it from being able to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Competitive Streak
enhancements.text: DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE model only. This unit may re-roll its charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Smoky Gubbinz
enhancements.text: SPEED FREEKS unit only (not AIRCRAFT units). Whenever an attack targets a unit that the attacking model cannot fully see because a model from this unit is in the way, the target gets the benefit of cover against that attack.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit.
EFFECT: Pick as many friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit as you like. Each picked unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit gain [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit picks a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit as a target.
TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.
EFFECT: Any ranged attack against your unit misses on an unmodified hit roll of 1, 2 or 3.

orks-taktikal-brigade.ruleText:
Friendly STORMBOYZ units gain BATTLELINE.
Whenever a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is chosen to make a fall-back move, making that move does not stop it from being able to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Kill Kommanda
enhancements.text: INFANTRY BIG MEK or WARBOSS model only. While this model is part of an attached unit, it has Infiltrators and Stealth.

enhancements.name: Throat-slittas
enhancements.text: KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit only. Melee attacks made by this unit have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit that is not engaged now but was engaged when the phase began.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is chosen to make an advance or fall-back move.
TARGET: That BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Making that move does not stop your unit from being able to start an action.

stratagems.name: Dubious Restraint
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the start or the end of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Pick one objective that your unit currently controls. That objective becomes secured.

dark-angels-assault-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

tyranids-invasion-fleet.ruleText:
At the start of the first battle round, choose one of these Hyper-adaptations; it applies to TYRANIDS units in your army for the rest of the battle:
Swarming Instincts: Attacks made by TYRANIDS models with this Hyper-adaptation against INFANTRY or SWARM units have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Hyper-aggression: Attacks made by TYRANIDS models with this Hyper-adaptation against MONSTER or VEHICLE units have [LETHAL HITS].
Hive Predators: Attacks made by TYRANIDS models with this Hyper-adaptation against CHARACTER units gain [PRECISION] when they score a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+. If, at the start of any turn, the bearer has fewer wounds remaining than its starting number, it has Feel No Pain 4+ instead for the rest of the battle.

enhancements.name: Alien Cunning
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once both players have finished deploying, pick up to three TYRANIDS units in your army and redeploy them. You may place any of them into Strategic Reserves when you do, no matter how many units are already there.

enhancements.name: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once per turn, you may re-roll one of the following made for the bearer: a Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, Advance roll, Charge roll or saving throw.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Any friendly TYRANIDS unit within 9" of the bearer counts as being within Synapse Range of your army.

stratagems.name: Adrenal Surge
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.
TARGET: Either up to two TYRANIDS units in your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit in your army that is eligible to fight.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, attacks made by models in the chosen units score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Rapid Regeneration
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 6+, or Feel No Pain 5+ instead if your unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

stratagems.name: Death Frenzy
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in your unit is destroyed and has not yet fought this phase, roll a D6. On a 4+, leave it on the battlefield for now: once the attacking model's unit has finished all its attacks, the destroyed model gets to fight, and then it is removed.

stratagems.name: Overrun
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, immediately before a TYRANIDS unit in your army Consolidates.
TARGET: That TYRANIDS unit.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, when your unit Consolidates its models may move 3" further, provided the unit can finish that move within Engagement Range of at least one enemy unit. Alternatively, if your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it may make a Normal move of up to 6" in place of the Consolidation move.

stratagems.name: Predatory Imperative
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: Either up to two TYRANIDS units in your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit in your army.
EFFECT: Pick one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, the chosen units also benefit from it, on top of any other Hyper-adaptation active for your army.
RESTRICTIONS: You may not pick the Hyper-adaptation you chose at the start of the first battle round.

stratagems.name: Endless Swarm
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: Either up to two ENDLESS MULTITUDE units in your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army.
EFFECT: Return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each chosen unit.

dark-angels-phobos-shadow-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

custodes-tharanatoi-hammerblow.ruleText:
If an ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit from your army made an ingress move this turn, it may re-roll its charge rolls.
This detachment carries the LIONS tag, so you cannot include it alongside any other LIONS detachment.

enhancements.name: Efficient Aggression
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR model. Once per turn for your whole army: in your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, if this unit lost at least one wound to those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

enhancements.name: Mnemo-locked Shrine Cipher
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR model. This unit can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.

stratagems.name: Electroexorcist Saturation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, at the moment an ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit from your army is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Its Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have an Attacks characteristic of D3+3.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
EFFECT: Break your unit up so that each model becomes its own separate unit. Each of these new units has a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Hardened Resolve
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, at the moment an enemy unit picks an ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit from your army as a target.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gets +1 to its Toughness.

dark-angels-tacticus-attack-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

custodes-shield-host.ruleText:
At the start of each battle round, you may pick one of the two effects below; if you do, that effect applies until the next battle round begins.
Effect 1: Whenever an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army that has the Martial Ka'tah ability makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is a Critical Hit.
Effect 2: Melee weapons carried by ADEPTUS CUSTODES models from your army that have the Martial Ka'tah ability get their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

enhancements.name: Auric Mantle
enhancements.text: Can only be given to a SHIELD-CAPTAIN or BLADE CHAMPION model. The bearer gets +2 to its Wounds characteristic.

enhancements.name: Castellan’s Mark
enhancements.text: Can only be given to a SHIELD-CAPTAIN model. Once both players have finished deploying, you may pick up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army (not ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) and redeploy them. While doing so, you may put any of them into Strategic Reserves, ignoring the usual limit on how many units can be in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.text: Can only be given to a SHIELD-CAPTAIN model. The bearer's melee weapons get +1 to their Strength and Damage characteristics.

enhancements.name: Panoptispex
enhancements.text: Can only be given to a SHIELD-CAPTAIN or BLADE CHAMPION model. While the bearer leads a unit, ranged weapons carried by models in that unit gain [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Archeotech Munitions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit) that has not yet been chosen to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Choose either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the phase ends, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit gain the chosen ability.

stratagems.name: Arcane Genetic Alchemy
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, immediately after a mortal wound is allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model).
TARGET: The unit containing that ADEPTUS CUSTODES model.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, models in your unit have Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Vigilance Eternal
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit) that is within range of an objective marker you control.
EFFECT: You keep control of that objective marker even when none of your models are within range of it, until your opponent takes control of it at the start or end of any turn.

stratagems.name: Multipotentiality
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of your turn, that unit can shoot and can declare a charge even though it Fell Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Unwavering Sentinels
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit) that is within range of an objective marker you control and was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, every melee attack that targets your unit suffers -1 to its Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit) that has fewer models than its Starting Strength.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, melee weapons carried by models in that unit get +1 to their Attacks characteristic. If your unit is Below Half-strength, they get +2 Attacks until the end of the phase instead.

custodes-solar-spearhead.ruleText:
While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army is at its Starting Strength, its models get +2 to their Objective Control characteristic — unless the unit is an AIRCRAFT or is Battle-shocked.
While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army is below its Starting Strength, whenever one of its models attacks, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army is Below Half-strength, whenever one of its models attacks, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
Moritoi Ancients: Models in ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units from your army get +2" to their Move characteristic, and those units add 1 to their Advance and Charge rolls.
Keywords: During the Muster Armies step, you may pick up to 2 ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER models from your army; they gain the CHARACTER keyword. (This lets them take Enhancements, and one of them can be your WARLORD.)

enhancements.name: Adamantine Talisman
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. The bearer's melee weapons get +1 to their Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Honoured Fallen
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE model. While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army is within 6" of the bearer, whenever a model in that unit attacks, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the Kataphraktoi
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED model. In your Command phase, pick one ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit within 6" of the bearer. Until your next Command phase begins, that unit can shoot even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Wrathful Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, immediately before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, each Pile-in move a model in your unit makes can be up to D3+3" rather than the usual 3".

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Vengeance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in your unit is destroyed and has not yet fought this phase, roll a D6 (add 1 if your unit has the WALKER keyword). On a 4+, leave it on the battlefield: once the attacking unit finishes all its attacks, that model can fight, counting as having 1 wound left, and is removed afterwards.

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, any attack against a model in your unit whose Strength is higher than your unit's Toughness suffers -1 to its Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, models in your unit can move through terrain features whenever they move.

stratagems.name: Relentless Persecution
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, immediately after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can shoot even though it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, it can instead both shoot and declare a charge this turn despite having Advanced.

stratagems.name: Punishment Inescapable
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit gain [IGNORES COVER], and whenever a model in your unit attacks you may disregard any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill and/or to its Hit roll.

orks-war-horde.ruleText: Melee attacks made by friendly ORKS units have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: Da Boss is Watchin'
enhancements.text: ORKS model only. Once per battle for your army: during your Movement phase, you may use this ability. When you do, this model's unit becomes riled up until your next turn begins.

enhancements.name: Follow Me Ladz
enhancements.text: ORKS model only. This model's unit gets +2" M.

enhancements.name: Headwoppa’s Killchoppa
enhancements.text: ORKS model only. If this model's unit made a charge move this turn, this model's melee attacks get +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Kunnin’ But Brutal
enhancements.text: ORKS model only. Whenever this unit is chosen to make a fall-back move, making that move does not stop it from being able to shoot or declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Mow 'em Down
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (not a WALKER unit) that made a charge move this turn is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks made by your unit gain [Cleave 1]; if an attack already has [CLEAVE], increase its value by 1 instead (for example, [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.name: Fungus-Fuel Injection
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit is chosen to move.
TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gets +2" M.

stratagems.name: Close-Range Dakka
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit gain [Rapid Fire 1]; if an attack already has [RAPID FIRE], increase its value by 1 instead (for example, [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.name: Hit 'em Harder
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, at the moment a friendly ORKS unit is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Until that unit finishes fighting, its melee attacks gain [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, at the moment an enemy unit picks a friendly ORKS unit (not a TITANIC unit) as a target of its attacks.
TARGET: That ORKS unit.
EFFECT: Whenever a model in your unit is destroyed, provided your unit has not yet been chosen to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is riled up. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield for now; it is removed either once your unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

stratagems.name: Breakin' Heads
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, at the moment a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes Battle-shocked.
TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. Being Battle-shocked does not stop you from choosing it for this Stratagem.
EFFECT: Roll one D3. Your unit suffers mortal wounds equal to the number rolled, and then it stops being Battle-shocked.

orks-runt-swarm.ruleText:
Friendly GRETCHIN units gain BATTLELINE.
Whenever a friendly GRETCHIN unit is chosen to make an advance or fall-back move, making that move does not stop that unit from being able to start an action.

enhancements.name: Extra Sneaky
enhancements.text: GRETCHIN unit only. This unit's detection range is reduced by 3".

enhancements.name: Minefield Detail
enhancements.text: GRETCHIN unit only. While it is not embarked, this unit has Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: Scarper!
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Movement phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a move within 8" of a friendly GRETCHIN unit that is not engaged.
TARGET: That GRETCHIN unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a normal move of up to D6", or of up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

stratagems.name: Infested War Zone
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, after an enemy unit has finished attacking.
TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed (it can be targeted even though it has been destroyed).
EFFECT: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army, identical to the destroyed one, at full starting strength and with all its wounds, and place it in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Grot Shields
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit picks a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (other than a GRETCHIN unit) as a target.
TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Each time a hit roll for one of that enemy unit's ranged attacks against that ORKS unit scores a hit, as long as your GRETCHIN unit still has a model on the battlefield, that attack's sequence ends immediately and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound instead.

orks-da-big-hunt.ruleText: Attacks made by friendly BEAST SNAGGA units against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit get +1 AP.

enhancements.name: Glory Hog
enhancements.text: BEAST SNAGGA model only. Whenever this unit is chosen to make a fall-back move, making that move does not stop it from being able to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: It Came from da Drops
enhancements.text: BEASTBOSS ON SQUIGOSAUR model only. This model gets +1 T.

stratagems.name: Goaded Into Action
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has finished shooting.
TARGET: One friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit that is not engaged and lost at least one wound because of those attacks.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, you may re-roll that D6.

stratagems.name: Instinctive Hunters
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit that is not engaged and is within 6" of any battlefield edge.
EFFECT: Put your unit into strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Where D'ya Fink You're Going?
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit that is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit is chosen to make a fall-back move.
TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.
EFFECT: Whenever an enemy unit engaged with your unit is chosen to make a fall-back move, it is forced to use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, it must make three extra hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, and if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from those extra hazard rolls.

dark-angels-tactical-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

tyranids-warrior-bioform-onslaught.ruleText:
TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS and TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS units in your army gain the TYRANID WARRIORS and BATTLELINE keywords.
TYRANID WARRIORS, TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP and WINGED TYRANID PRIME models in your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Elevated Might
enhancements.text:
Only a WINGED TYRANID PRIME or TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP model can take this. The melee attacks this model makes:
May re-roll the Wound roll.
Gain +1 to their Armour Penetration (AP improved by 1).

enhancements.name: Ocular Adaptation
enhancements.text: Only a WINGED TYRANID PRIME or TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP model can take this. Melee attacks made by the bearer's unit get +1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Micronodes
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANID WARRIORS unit from your army.
EFFECT: Pick one objective marker that your unit controls. That objective becomes secured (you keep control of it even if your unit moves away, until your opponent takes control of it).

stratagems.name: Parasitic Payload
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase, when a TYRANID WARRIORS unit from your army is picked to shoot.
TARGET: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit gain [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Alien Physiology
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, when an enemy unit picks a TYRANID WARRIORS unit from your army as a target.
TARGET: That TYRANID WARRIORS unit.
EFFECT: Each attack targeting your unit whose Strength is higher than your unit's Toughness gets -1 to its Wound roll.

tyranids-crusher-stampede.ruleText:
Whenever a TYRANIDS MONSTER model in your army attacks, add 1 to the Hit roll if its unit is below Starting Strength; if its unit is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll too.
While a TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army is at its Starting Strength and is not Battle-shocked, its models get +2 Objective Control.

enhancements.name: Enraged Reserves
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. When the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack and has not yet fought this phase, roll a D6. On a 3+, leave it on the battlefield for now: after the attacking model's unit finishes all its attacks, the bearer gets to fight, and then it is removed.

enhancements.name: Monstrous Nemesis
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Add 1 to the Wound roll whenever the bearer makes a melee attack against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.

enhancements.name: Null Nodules
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Once per battle, when a Psychic Attack is allocated to the bearer, you can activate this ability; the bearer then has Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks until the phase ends.

enhancements.name: Ominous Presence
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. The bearer gets +3 Objective Control.

stratagems.name: Swarm-Guided Salvoes
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, ranged weapons of models in your unit gain [IGNORES COVER], and whenever a model in your unit attacks, you may disregard any or all modifiers to its Ballistic Skill and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Rampaging Monstrosities
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, you may re-roll the Hit roll for every attack made by a model in your unit.

stratagems.name: Savage Roar
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: The enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the phase ends, its models subtract 1 from the Hit roll when attacking your unit; if the enemy unit failed that Battle-shock test, they also subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Massive Impact
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, right after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model in your army finishes a Charge move.
TARGET: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6. The enemy unit takes 1 mortal wound for each result of 4+.

stratagems.name: Corrosive Viscera
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after a TYRANIDS MONSTER model in your army that has Deadly Demise and does not have FLY is destroyed.
TARGET: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You may use this Stratagem on it despite it having just been destroyed.
EFFECT: Skip the D6 roll for your model's Deadly Demise ability; its mortal wounds are inflicted automatically.

stratagems.name: Untrammelled Ferocity
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to move this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can pass through models (other than TITANIC models) and through terrain sections 4" tall or less. While doing so:
- It may move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but must not finish the move within Engagement Range of them.
- It may also pass through terrain sections taller than 4"; if it does, roll a D6 once its unit has finished moving, and on a 1 your unit becomes Battle-shocked.

orks-green-tide.ruleText:
Melee attacks made by friendly BOYZ units have [Sustained Hits 1].
If a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit made a charge move this turn, its melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Monster/Vehicle] (Lethal Hits that only apply against units that are not MONSTER or VEHICLE units).

enhancements.name: 'Ardboyz
enhancements.text: BOYZ unit only. This unit has a 4+ Sv.

enhancements.name: Ferocious Show Off
enhancements.text: ORKS INFANTRY model only. Melee attacks made by this model get +1 A, or +2 A instead if its unit contains 11 or more models.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Carnage
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That BOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks made by your unit get +1 A.

stratagems.name: 'ere We Go
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit is chosen to move.
TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit.
EFFECT: Add 2 to your unit's advance rolls.

stratagems.name: Mob Mentality
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit containing 13 or more models.
EFFECT: Pick one friendly ORKS unit that is visible to and within 12" of your unit. Battle-shock rolls taken for that unit automatically succeed.

orks-brute-bosses.ruleText: Each time a friendly WARBOSS model is destroyed, if its unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the roll if that unit is riled up. On a 3+, leave that WARBOSS model on the battlefield for now; it is removed after its unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

enhancements.name: Blitzboss
enhancements.text: WARBOSS model only. Any TRANSPORT unit (other than a WALKER unit) that this model's unit is embarked inside gains +2" M and a 5+ InSv.

enhancements.name: Brutal But Kunnin’
enhancements.text: WARBOSS model only. Melee attacks made by this model get +1 D.

enhancements.name: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss
enhancements.text: WARBOSS model only. This model is equipped with the additional weapon shown in this enhancement's profile.

enhancements.name: Morgog’s Finkin’ Cap
enhancements.text: WARBOSS model only. Once per battle for your army: at the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is not engaged, it may make a normal move of up to D6". If this unit is riled up, you may re-roll that D6.

enhancements.name: Proper Killy
enhancements.text: WARBOSS model only. You may re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this model's attacks.

enhancements.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
enhancements.text: INFANTRY WARBOSS model only. Once per battle for your army: at the end of any phase in which this model was destroyed, roll one D6. On a 2+, put this model back on the battlefield as near as possible to the spot where it was destroyed, not engaged with any enemy unit, with 3 wounds left.

dark-angels-darkflight-pursuit.ruleText:
Ranged attacks made by friendly RAVENWING FLY units have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
Restrictions: Your army may contain DARK ANGELS units, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Nightforged Battery
enhancements.text:
LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE unit only. This unit may re-roll the following:
- Rolls made to determine a weapon's Attacks (A) characteristic.
- Hazard rolls.

enhancements.name: Thundercowl Turbines
enhancements.text: RAVENWING FLY unit only. During your first Movement phase, this unit may make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Surveillance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase, after a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit has shot.
TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.
EFFECT: Enemy units that are visible and within 6" of your unit get +3" added to their detection range.

stratagems.name: Wings of Shadow
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit selects a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit as a target.
TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gains Stealth.

stratagems.name: We Are Vengeance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, if it targeted a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit that is not engaged.
TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

custodes-silent-hunters.ruleText:
When an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army is chosen to Advance, having Advanced does not stop it from being eligible to start an action.
Your ANATHEMA PSYKANA units also have this ability:
Ceaseless Vigilance: In your Shooting phase, this unit may pick one enemy unit within 12" that is visible to it. That enemy unit becomes nulled. A nulled unit has its detection range increased by 3".

enhancements.name: Encircling Hunter
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model. Once both players have finished deploying, you may redeploy up to three ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY units from your army. While doing so, you may put them into Strategic Reserves, ignoring the usual limit on how many units can be in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Psyk-out Grenades
enhancements.text:
Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit.
This unit gains EXPLOSIVES.
When you use the Explosives Stratagem on this unit and pick an enemy PSYKER unit, you may re-roll the dice that decide whether that enemy unit suffers a mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Umbral Prosecution
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, at the moment a PROSECUTORS unit from your army is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That PROSECUTORS unit.
EFFECT: Its Boltgun weapons gain [RAPID FIRE 2] and get +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Deathsong Scythes
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, at the moment a VIGILATORS unit from your army is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That VIGILATORS unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's melee attacks gain [LANCE].
Your unit's melee attacks against a PSYKER unit get +1 A.

stratagems.name: Synchronised Inferno
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, at the moment a WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That WITCHSEEKERS unit.
EFFECT: Your unit's ranged attacks that have [TORRENT] also gain [BLAST 1].

dark-angels-gravis-siege-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

dark-angels-gladius-task-force.ruleText:
At the start of your Command phase, you may choose one of the Combat Doctrines below. It is active for all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units in your army until the start of your next Command phase. Each Combat Doctrine can only be chosen once per battle.
Devastator Doctrine: Units can shoot in a turn in which they Advanced.
Tactical Doctrine: Units can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
Assault Doctrine: Units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you may choose the Tactical Doctrine instead of choosing a Combat Doctrine for your army. If you do, the Tactical Doctrine is active only for the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase, and this is allowed even if you have already chosen the Tactical Doctrine for your army earlier in the battle.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer's Save characteristic is 2+ and it has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Honour the Chapter
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons carried by models in your unit gain the [LANCE] ability. If the Assault Doctrine is active for your unit, those weapons also get +1 to their Armour Penetration characteristic until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Storm of Fire
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not yet been selected to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit gain the [IGNORES COVER] ability. If the Devastator Doctrine is active for your unit, those weapons also get +1 to their Armour Penetration characteristic until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Only in Death Does Duty End
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, whenever a model in your unit is destroyed and has not yet fought this phase, leave it on the battlefield. Once the attacking unit has finished all of its attacks, that destroyed model can fight, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Squad Tactics
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Movement phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army within 8" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a Normal move of up to D6", or up to 6" if the Tactical Doctrine is active for it.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot pick a unit that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Strategy
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
EFFECT: Choose the Devastator, Tactical or Assault Doctrine. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for this unit in place of whatever Combat Doctrine is active for your army, even if you have already chosen that doctrine earlier in the battle.

dark-angels-wrath-of-the-rock.ruleText: Whenever an attack targets an ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army and that attack's Strength characteristic is higher than that unit's Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Melee weapons carried by the bearer get +2 to their Strength characteristic and +1 to their Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can be set up with the Deep Strike ability during the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, ignoring any mission rules that would prevent this.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.text: RAVENWING model only. You may re-roll Advance rolls and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. You may re-roll Battle-shock tests and Leadership tests taken for any friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit while it is within 6" of this model.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, right after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit on the battlefield.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit that is within 12" of and visible to your unit. It becomes your Oath of Moment target until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the RAVENWING keyword, it can also shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Lion’s Will
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of at least one enemy unit.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, models in your unit get +1 to their Objective Control characteristic. Also, until the end of the turn, if your unit does not have the DEATHWING, RAVENWING or VEHICLE keyword, add 1 to the Hit roll whenever a model in your unit makes an attack.

stratagems.name: Leonine Aggression
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Charge phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is within 3" of at least one enemy unit, or one DEATHWING unit from your army that is within 6" of at least one enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit declares a charge targeting only one or more of those enemy units, and you then resolve that charge.
RESTRICTIONS: Even if the charge succeeds, your unit gets no Charge bonus this turn.

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army that has not yet been selected to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit get +2 to their Strength characteristic.

dark-angels-terminator-storm-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

orks-dread-mob.ruleText:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (not a TITANIC unit) is chosen to attack, you may use this ability. Roll either one D6 or two D6 (if rolling two, re-roll any duplicates until the results differ). For each die result, this unit's attacks gain the matching effect: 1-2 = +1 A; 3-4 = +2 S; 5-6 = +1 AP.
If you chose to roll two D6, this unit must make one hazard roll after it has finished attacking.

enhancements.name: Cybork Boosta
enhancements.text: BIG MEK or MEK model only. This model gets +2" M.

enhancements.name: Dreadherder
enhancements.text:
BIG MEK model only. As long as this model is within 3" of a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (not counting BIG MEK units):
This model has Lone Operative.
During your Shooting phase, you may pick one friendly ORKS WALKER unit within 3" of this model; until the end of the turn, that unit's attacks may re-roll hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Crazed Rampage
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase, when an enemy unit picks a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (not a TITANIC unit) as a target.
TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not yet been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 3 to the result if your unit includes a Deff Dread. On a 4+, leave that model on the battlefield for now; it is removed after your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever happens first.

stratagems.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase or Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is chosen to move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gains MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Dread Power
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit becomes riled up until your next turn begins.

dark-angels-ironstorm-spearhead.ruleText: For each ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit in your army, once per phase you may re-roll a single Hit roll, Wound roll or Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

stratagems.name: Mercy Is Weakness
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase or in the Fight phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not yet been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, whenever a model in your unit attacks a unit that is below its Starting Strength, the attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability; if the attacking model is a VEHICLE, such an attack also scores a Critical Hit on a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Unbowed Conviction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is below its Starting Strength.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit may ignore any or all modifiers to its characteristics and/or to any rolls or tests made for it, except modifiers to saving throws.

stratagems.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army that was brought to Below Half-strength by that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Your unit may shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but only at that enemy unit, and only if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Ancient Fury
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Command phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER model from your army.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to your model's Move, Toughness, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics, and add 1 to the Hit roll whenever your model makes an attack.

stratagems.name: Vengeful Animus
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, right after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model from your army that has the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model (you may use this Stratagem on it even though it has just been destroyed).
EFFECT: Skip the D6 roll that decides whether your model's Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds; the mortal wounds are inflicted automatically.

tyranids-vanguard-onslaught.ruleText:
TYRANIDS units with this ability can declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
VANGUARD INVADER units with this ability can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced.

enhancements.name: Chameleonic
enhancements.text: VANGUARD INVADER model only. This unit has Stealth.

enhancements.name: Hunting Grounds
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a unit from Reserves, roll a D6; on a 2+, that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Neuronode
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Once both players have finished deploying, you may pick up to three VANGUARD INVADER units in your army and redeploy them all. Any of them may be put into Strategic Reserves when you do, no matter how many units are already there.

enhancements.name: Stalker
enhancements.text: VANGUARD INVADER model only. At the start of the battle, choose one enemy unit. Whenever the bearer attacks that unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Surprise Assault
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after a VANGUARD INVADER unit in your army has chosen its targets.
TARGET: That VANGUARD INVADER unit.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit chosen as a target of at least one of your unit's attacks; it must take a Battle-shock test. Until the phase ends, add 1 to the Hit roll for your unit's attacks against that enemy unit, and if it failed the Battle-shock test, add 1 to the Wound roll too.

stratagems.name: Assassin Beasts
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.
TARGET: One VANGUARD INVADER INFANTRY unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, melee weapons of models in your unit gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Invisible Hunter
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: Either up to two VANGUARD INVADER units in your army, or one TYRANIDS INFANTRY unit in your army.
EFFECT: Take the targeted units off the battlefield and put them into Strategic Reserves.
RESTRICTIONS: Every targeted unit must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

stratagems.name: Unseen Lurkers
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has picked its targets.
TARGET: One Vanguard Invader unit from your army that was picked as a target for one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, your unit can be targeted by a ranged attack only if the attacking model is within 18" of it (or within 6" instead, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability). Your opponent may then pick new targets for the attacking unit's attacks.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Scillia
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Movement phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: Either up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army within 8" of that enemy unit, or one other Tyranids Infantry unit from your army within 8" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Each chosen unit may make a Normal move of up to 6".
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot pick any unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Seeded Broods
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Movement phase.
TARGET: Either one TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army that are in Reserves.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, when setting up the chosen units on the battlefield, count the battle round as one higher than the actual current battle round.

orks-shoota-boyz.ruleText:
Ranged attacks made by friendly ORKS INFANTRY units have [Assault].
While such a unit is riled up, its ranged attacks also get +3" R.

enhancements.name: Supa-glowy Fing
enhancements.text:
ORKS INFANTRY model only (not WEIRDBOY models). This model's ranged attacks have [Anti-Infantry 4+], [Devastating Wounds] and [SUPA-HAZARDOUS].
[SUPA-HAZARDOUS]: whenever a unit is chosen to shoot, once it has resolved all its attacks, it must make two hazard rolls for every [SUPA-HAZARDOUS] weapon chosen for it in the Select Weapons step.

enhancements.name: Targetin' Squigs
enhancements.text: BIG MEK, BIGBOSS or WARBOSS model only. Ranged attacks made by this unit get +3" R, except attacks with [Torrent].

stratagems.name: Glowin' Dakka
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit against a target within 9" get +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Never Enough Dakka
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit gain [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Kustom Dakka
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Ranged attacks made by your unit against any unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE get +1 to their wound rolls.

custodes-null-maiden-vigil.ruleText:
During the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, any enemy unit within 12" of at least one ANATHEMA PSYKANA model from your army that is either a PSYKER unit or has fewer models than its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, it instead takes the test with a -1 modifier this phase.
Designer's Note: Every enemy PSYKER unit in range, and every enemy unit in range that has lost at least one model, must test in your opponent's Command phase — not only units that are Below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model. Whenever an attack is allocated to the bearer, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1. If the attacking model was a PSYKER or was Battle-shocked, set that attack's Damage characteristic to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model. In your Command phase, pick one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model. While the bearer leads a unit, every attack made by a model in that unit gets +1 to its Hit roll. If the attack's target is an enemy PSYKER unit, it also gets +1 to its Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Raptor Blade
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model. The bearer's melee weapons get +1 to their Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics. While the bearer is within Engagement Range of at least one Battle-shocked enemy PSYKER unit, they get +2 to those characteristics instead.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, Torrent weapons carried by models in your unit get +1 to their Attacks characteristic. When such a weapon targets a PSYKER unit or a Battle-shocked unit this phase, it gets +2 Attacks instead.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase.
TARGET: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not yet been chosen to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you may re-roll its Hit roll. If that attack's target is Battle-shocked or is a PSYKER, you may also re-roll its Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Witch Hunters
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot or fight this phase.
EFFECT: Choose either [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the phase ends, weapons carried by models in your unit gain the chosen ability, but models in your unit may only target PSYKER units with their attacks.

stratagems.name: Psychic Abominations
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked models and PSYKER models can only choose your unit as the target of a ranged attack if they are within 12" of it.

stratagems.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just finished shooting.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit that was hit by at least one of those attacks. That enemy unit becomes prosecuted until the start of your next turn, for as long as your unit remains on the battlefield. Whenever an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model attacks a prosecuted unit, improve that attack's Armour Penetration by 1. If the prosecuted unit is a PSYKER unit or is Battle-shocked, every attack made by a model in that unit suffers -1 to its Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Desperation’s Price
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, immediately after an enemy PSYKER unit finishes either resolving a Psychic ability that targets a unit or making Psychic Attacks.
TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that is within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
EFFECT: That enemy PSYKER unit takes a Leadership test. If it passes, it becomes Battle-shocked. If it fails, it suffers 3 mortal wounds and becomes Battle-shocked.

custodes-lions-of-the-emperor.ruleText: Whenever a model in an Adeptus Custodes unit from your army (VEHICLE units excluded) attacks, if no other friendly units are within 6" of its unit, add 1 to both the Hit roll and the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Admonimortis
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain model only. The bearer's melee weapons get +3 Strength, and their Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics are each improved by 1.

enhancements.name: Fierce Conqueror
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain model only. At the start of the Fight phase, count the enemy models within 6" of the bearer; for every full 5 of them, the bearer's melee weapons get +2 to their Attacks characteristic until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Praesidius
enhancements.text: Adeptus Custodes model only. The bearer has the Lone Operative and Stealth abilities.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.text: Adeptus Custodes Infantry model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of that phase: on 2+, set it back up on the battlefield as near as possible to where it was destroyed, not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with all of its wounds remaining.

stratagems.name: Peerless Warrior
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During the Fight phase.
