TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not yet been picked to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, melee weapons carried by models in your unit gain [PRECISION].

stratagems.name: Swift As the Eagle
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has finished shooting.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (not a VEHICLE) that was picked as a target for one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase, right after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the turn ends, your unit can shoot and declare a charge even though it Fell Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Command phase.
TARGET: One Allarus Custodians or Aquilon Custodians unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
EFFECT: Break that unit up into separate units of one model each. Each new unit has a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Defiant to the Last
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has picked its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was picked as a target for one or more of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in your unit is destroyed before it has fought this phase, roll a D6 (add 2 if that model has the CHARACTER keyword). On 4+, leave it on the battlefield: once the attacking unit has finished its attacks, that model can fight (counting as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Gilded Champion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, immediately after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model in your army uses a datasheet ability that is limited to once per battle.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.
EFFECT: That model may use the same once-per-battle ability one more time later in the battle, but not again in the phase in which it just used it.
RESTRICTIONS: Each ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model can be targeted by this Stratagem only once per battle.

dark-angels-inner-circle-task-force.ruleText:
At the start of your Movement phase, choose one option:
Defensive Footing: Pick one objective you control. It is your Vowed objective until the start of your next Movement phase.
Aggressive Push: Pick one or more objectives you do not control. Each of them is one of your Vowed objectives until the start of your next Movement phase. Any rule that checks whether a unit or model is within range of your Vowed objective applies if it is within range of any of your Vowed objectives. Whenever a DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army makes an attack against a unit that is within range of one or more of your Vowed objectives, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Restrictions: Your army may contain DARK ANGELS units, but no ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model only. The bearer's melee weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. In addition, whenever the bearer makes a melee attack while within range of your Vowed objective marker, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model only. Whenever the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, its models may move up to 3" further.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Unmatched Fortitude
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, whenever an attack targets your unit and that attack's Strength characteristic is higher than your unit's Toughness characteristic, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Martial Mastery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase.
TARGET: One DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army that has not yet been selected to fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, whenever a model in your unit makes an attack, you may re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker, you may instead re-roll the Wound roll entirely.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Lion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Charge phase.
TARGET: One DEATHWING INFANTRY unit from your army that has just finished a Charge move.
EFFECT: Pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit. Roll one D6 per model in your unit, adding 1 to each result if that enemy unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker. For every 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound, up to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One DEATHWING unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, whenever a model in your unit is destroyed and has not yet fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is within range of your Vowed objective marker. On a 4+, leave the destroyed model on the battlefield; once the attacking unit has finished all of its attacks, it can fight, and is then removed from play.

stratagems.name: Relic Teleportarium
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase.
TARGET: One DEATHWING unit from your army that is arriving via the Deep Strike ability this phase.
EFFECT: Your unit may be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally from every enemy model.
RESTRICTIONS: Your unit cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

dark-angels-stormlance-task-force.ruleText: ADEPTUS ASTARTES units in your army can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until that enemy unit has resolved all of its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Ride Hard, Ride Fast
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY VEHICLE unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Wound roll for every attack that targets your unit.

stratagems.name: Shock Assault
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks made by your unit have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: Blitzing Fusillade
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not yet been selected to shoot this phase.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons carried by models in your unit gain the [ASSAULT] ability; any of those weapons that already had [ASSAULT] gain the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability as well until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Wind-Swift Evasion
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Movement phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit from your army within 8" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your unit may make a Normal move of up to 6".
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot pick a unit that is within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

stratagems.name: Full Throttle
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit from your army (WALKERS cannot be chosen).
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, if your unit Advances, don't roll for the Advance; instead, add 6" to the Move characteristic of its models until the end of the phase, or 9" if your unit is MOUNTED.

tyranids-unending-swarm.ruleText: During your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model from a friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit, that friendly unit may make a surge move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Whenever the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, its models may move 3" further.

enhancements.name: Naturalised Camouflage
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. At the start of the first battle round, pick up to three friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE units within 9" of the bearer. Until that battle round ends, models in those units have the Benefit of Cover against every ranged attack that targets their unit.

enhancements.name: Piercing Talons
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Whenever a model in the bearer's unit attacks and scores a Critical Wound, that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

enhancements.name: Relentless Hunger
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS model only. Models in the bearer's unit get +2" to their Move characteristic.

stratagems.name: Bounding Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, when your unit Advances you do not roll for the Advance; instead its models add 6" to their Move characteristic until the phase ends.

stratagems.name: Swarming Masses
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot or fight this phase.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, weapons of models in your unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If your unit has 15 or more models, its models' attacks also score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

stratagems.name: Teeming Masses
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, every attack that targets your unit subtracts 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Preservation Imperative
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, your unit counts as having fewer than five models for the purposes of the [BLAST] ability.

stratagems.name: Unending Waves
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase.
TARGET: One ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army that has just been destroyed. You may use this Stratagem on it despite it having just been destroyed.
EFFECT: Add a new unit to your army, identical to the destroyed one and at its Starting Strength, placed in Strategic Reserves.
RESTRICTIONS: Any CHARACTER units that were attached to your unit and destroyed do not come back. This Stratagem can be used only once per battle.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Goading
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, immediately before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit in your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move.
TARGET: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit.
EFFECT: For that surge move, you may re-roll the D6 that sets the distance, and your unit may finish the move as close as possible to the nearest objective marker rather than the nearest enemy unit. All other surge move rules still apply.

dark-angels-gravis-linebreaker-force.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

dark-angels-devastator-brethren.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

orks-madcap-meks.ruleText:
In your Shooting phase, whenever a friendly BIG MEK, MEK GUNZ, MORKANAUT or WAZBOM BLASTAJET unit directs all of its ranged attacks at one single enemy unit, roll one D6 and apply the result:
1 - Dat's Weird: the target has a 4+ InSv until your unit finishes shooting.
2-3 - Hop Splat: pick a different enemy unit within 3" of the target; it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
4 - Seekerz: those attacks get +1 to hit rolls.
5 - Lifted: until your unit finishes shooting, the target gains FLY and cannot receive the benefit of cover.
6 - Runtified: the target gets -1 T until your unit finishes shooting.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Runt-maw
enhancements.text:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. After this unit has shot, pick one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks; it becomes infested with Snotlings until your next turn starts.
An enemy unit infested with Snotlings subtracts 1 from its leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Mekwaaagh! Mastermind
enhancements.text: BIG MEK model only. This unit is always riled up.

enhancements.name: Temperamental Shokka
enhancements.text:
BIG MEK WITH SHOKK ATTACK GUN model only. During your Shooting phase, when this unit is chosen to shoot, you may roll one D6:
1: this model's Shokk Attack Gun gains [Torrent], but once this unit has finished shooting, this model is destroyed.
2-5: this model's Shokk Attack Gun gets +1 A.
6: this model's Shokk Attack Gun gains [Sustained Hits 2].

stratagems.name: Vindictive Artillerists
stratagems.text:
WHEN: During your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That MEK GUNZ unit.
EFFECT: Choose one option for your unit's ranged attacks: they gain [Lethal Hits]; or they gain [Sustained Hits 1]; or they gain [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits] and [Sustained Hits 1] together.

custodes-talons-of-the-emperor.ruleText:
Your ANATHEMA PSYKANA units gain this ability:
Null Aegis (Aura): While an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is within 6" of this unit, its models have Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.
Every other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit in your army gains this ability:
Deadly Unity (Aura): While an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is within 6" of this unit, every attack made by a model in that ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit gets +1 to its Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Aegis Projector
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. Once per turn, the first time a saving throw fails for the bearer's unit, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Imperium
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. The bearer's Null Aegis or Deadly Unity ability reaches 9" instead of 6".

enhancements.name: Gift of Terran Artifice
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. Every melee attack the bearer makes gets +1 to its Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model. Whenever an attack targets the bearer's unit and the attacking model is within 12", that attack suffers -1 to its Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Empyric Severance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks, plus one ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Emperor’s Executioners
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a model in either of your units attacks an enemy unit that has fewer models than its Starting Strength, that attack gets +1 to its Wound roll.
RESTRICTIONS: You may only pick two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and the two are within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Taloned Pincer
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, immediately after an enemy unit finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army within 8" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Your units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot pick a unit that is within Engagement Range of any enemy unit. You may only pick two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and the two are within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Talons Interlocked
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.
TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, plus one enemy unit that is an eligible target for every one of those units.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, your units may only target that enemy unit, but each ranged attack made by a model in your units gets +1 to its Strength and its Armour Penetration improved by 1.
RESTRICTIONS: You may only pick two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and the two are within 6" of each other.

stratagems.name: Shield of Honour
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, immediately after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was picked as a target of at least one of that enemy unit's attacks, plus one other ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (not an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit) within 6" of it.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, any attack aimed at your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is redirected to your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit instead, unless that unit is not an eligible target.

stratagems.name: Hunt As One
stratagems.text:
WHEN: The start of your Movement phase.
TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your units can shoot and/or declare a charge even if they Fell Back this turn.
RESTRICTIONS: You may only pick two units if exactly one of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and the two are within 6" of each other.

tyranids-ambush-predators.ruleText:
Friendly DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR and NEUROLICTOR units gain Deep Strike.
Friendly LICTOR and NEUROLICTOR units may re-roll Hit rolls of 1 when attacking a CHARACTER unit.

enhancements.name: Cryptophotaic Camouflage
enhancements.text: VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit only. Reduce this unit's detection range by 3".

enhancements.name: Encircling Horrors
enhancements.text: NEUROLICTOR, LICTOR or VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit only. During your opponent's Movement phase, whenever an enemy unit finishes a move within 8" of this unit, this unit may immediately make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Counterpredation
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, at the moment a friendly DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR, NEUROLICTOR or VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit is chosen to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Attacks your unit makes against a hidden unit get +1 Strength and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Scanner Gheist
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR or NEUROLICTOR unit that is not Engaged.
EFFECT: Put your unit into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Hypersensory Adaptations
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the start of your Shooting phase.
TARGET: One friendly DEATHLEAPER, LICTOR, NEUROLICTOR or VON RYAN'S LEAPERS unit.
EFFECT: Choose one enemy unit that is visible to your unit and within 12" of it. That enemy unit's detection range is increased by 6".

orks-wurrband.ruleText:
[Psychic] attacks made by friendly ORKS PSYKER models get +1 Strength, plus a further +1 Strength for every 5 models in this unit (or embarked within this model).
Friendly ORKS PSYKER models also gain these psychic abilities:
Roar of Mork (psychic level 1): In your Movement phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you may make a psychic roll for it by rolling one D6. If you do: on a roll of 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. Then pick one enemy unit (not a MONSTER or VEHICLE) within 12" of this unit; it must take a Battle-shock roll, subtracting 1 from that roll for every 10 models in this unit.
Visions of Violence (psychic level 1): At the start of the Fight phase, if this unit is not Battle-shocked, you may make a psychic roll for it by rolling one D6. If you do: on a roll of 1, this unit becomes Battle-shocked. This unit gains Fights First.

enhancements.name: Da Krunch
enhancements.text: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model gains the Da Krunch weapon (see its weapon profile).

enhancements.name: 'Eadbanger
enhancements.text: ORKS PSYKER model only. This model gains the 'Eadbanger weapon (see its weapon profile).

enhancements.name: Warphead
enhancements.text:
ORKS PSYKER model only. This model:
- Becomes psyker level 2.
- Gains Deadly Demise D6.
- May re-roll its psychic rolls.

custodes-might-of-the-moritoi.ruleText:
Your ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units get +2" to their Move characteristic.
Your ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER units add 1 to their Advance rolls and Charge rolls.
This detachment carries the ARMOURY tag, so you cannot include it alongside any other ARMOURY detachment.

enhancements.name: Auramite Sarcophagus
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit. Whenever you use the Crushing Impact Stratagem on this unit, it costs 1 CP less.

enhancements.name: Interred Expertise
enhancements.text: Can only be given to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit. Each time this unit attacks, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Prioritised Eradication
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, at the moment a TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit from your army is chosen to shoot.
TARGET: That TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Its Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons gain [RAPID FIRE 6].
Its Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons gain [RAPID FIRE 2].

stratagems.name: Flawless Construction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, at the moment an enemy unit picks an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit from your army as a target.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Any attack against your unit whose Strength is higher than your unit's Toughness suffers -1 to its Wound roll.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Advance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the moment an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit from your army is chosen to move.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
EFFECT: Your unit gains MOBILE.

dark-angels-deathwatch-support.ruleText: Rules arrive with the new Dark Angels codex. Points, dispositions and enhancement costs are from the Munitorum Field Manual.

tyranids-synaptic-nexus.ruleText:
At the start of each battle round, you may choose one of the Synaptic Imperatives below. It stays active for your army until that battle round ends, and any TYRANIDS unit in your army that is within Synapse Range of your army gains its benefit. You can choose each Synaptic Imperative only once per battle.
Synaptic Augmentation: while within Synapse Range of your army, this unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save.
Surging Vitality: while within Synapse Range of your army, this unit adds 1 to its Advance and Charge rolls.
Goaded to Slaughter: while within Synapse Range of your army, this unit's models add 1 to the Hit roll for melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Power of the Hive Mind
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS PSYKER model only. The bearer's psychic weapons get +1 Strength and have their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

enhancements.name: Psychostatic Disruption
enhancements.text:
TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.
Also, once per battle, in the first or second battle round, when your opponent announces that a unit is arriving from Strategic Reserves, the bearer can use this Enhancement: roll a D6, and on a 4+ that enemy unit cannot arrive this turn.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Control
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. Whenever an attack is allocated to the bearer, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1.

enhancements.name: The Dirgeheart of Kharis
enhancements.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE model only. Enemy units within 9" of the bearer have their Leadership characteristic worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Irresistible Will
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit in your army that has not yet been chosen to shoot or fight this phase, plus one enemy unit that is visible to that SYNAPSE unit and within 24" of it.
EFFECT: Until the phase ends, whenever a friendly TYRANIDS model attacks that enemy unit and the attacker's unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Synaptic Channelling
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Command phase.
TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit in your army.
EFFECT: Until the turn ends, any friendly TYRANIDS unit within 9" of the chosen unit counts as being within Synapse Range of your army.

stratagems.name: Reinforced Hive Node
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, right after an enemy unit has chosen its targets.
TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit in your army that was chosen as a target of at least one of that attacking unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished all its attacks, every attack that targets your unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

stratagems.name: Override Instincts
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and Fell Back this phase.
EFFECT: Your unit can still shoot and declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: The Smothering Shadow
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Any phase, right after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
TARGET: One SYNAPSE unit in your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Roll six D6. The enemy unit takes 1 mortal wound for each result of 3+.

stratagems.name: Imperative Dominance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One TYRANIDS unit in your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.
EFFECT: Pick a Synaptic Imperative, even one already chosen earlier this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative applies to your unit in place of any other Synaptic Imperative active for your army.

stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In any phase, right after you make one of the following for a unit from your army: an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test; or, for a model in that unit, a Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, or a roll to determine how many attacks a weapon it is equipped with makes. If you are fast dice rolling, you can still use this after rolling several rolls or saving throws together.
TARGET: That unit or model from your army.
EFFECT: Re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you rolled several dice at once with fast dice rolling, choose one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.

stratagems.name: Epic Challenge
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of at least one Attached unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, every melee attack that model makes has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Insane Bravery
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In the Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit passes that Battle-shock test automatically.
RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

stratagems.name: Explosives
stratagems.text: Your Shooting phase. A friendly unengaged Explosives or Grenades unit that's eligible to shoot and didn't Advance picks one of its Explosives/Grenades models and an unengaged visible enemy within 8" of it. Roll six D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Crushing Impact
stratagems.text: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly Monster or Vehicle ends a charge move. Pick an engaged enemy unit and one of your models engaged with it, then roll D6 equal to that model's T: each 1 deals a mortal wound to your unit, each 5+ deals one to the enemy (max 6 per unit).

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.text:
WHEN: At the end of your opponent's Movement phase.
TARGET: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.
EFFECT: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as though it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase. If every model in the unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set it up following the Deep Strike rules, even though it is not your Movement phase.
RESTRICTIONS: This Stratagem cannot let a unit arrive during a battle round in which it would not normally be allowed to arrive.

stratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Movement phase or Charge phase, right after an enemy unit is set up, starts or finishes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.
TARGET: One unit from your army within 24" of that enemy unit that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.
EFFECT: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot at it as though it were your Shooting phase.
RESTRICTIONS: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, your unit's ranged attacks only hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 6, regardless of the weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Shooting phase, right after an enemy unit picks its targets.
TARGET: One SMOKE unit from your army that was chosen as a target for at least one of that enemy unit's attacks.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, every model in your unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.text:
WHEN: In your opponent's Charge phase, right after an enemy unit finishes a Charge move.
TARGET: One unit from your army within 6" of that enemy unit that would be able to declare a charge against it if it were your Charge phase.
EFFECT: Your unit declares a charge targeting only that enemy unit, and you resolve the charge as though it were your Charge phase.
RESTRICTIONS: A VEHICLE unit can only be chosen if it is a WALKER. Even if the charge succeeds, your unit gets no Charge bonus this turn.
End of your opponent's Charge phase. One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of an enemy (Vehicles only if Character or Walker) resolves a charge. Leap to Defend: only target enemies that charged this phase. Into the Fray (+1 CP): charge roll capped at 6, and you can target any enemy within 6".

stratagems.name: Counteroffensive
stratagems.text: Fight step of your opponent's Fight phase, just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks. One friendly unit eligible to fight gains Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.
